search.url:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
body = "{{key}}";
1 == flag ? "/search?keyword=" + body : java.toast("\n❗未启用书源❗");
</js>
search.listSelector:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
var list = java.getElements(".book-list li"), data = [];
for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) data.push({
    name: list[i].select(".book-list-info-title").text(), author: String(list[i].select(".book-list-info-bottom-item").text()).replace(/[\s&\|]|[圖文][:：]/g, "/").replace(/\/\/\/|\/\/|;|amp/g, ""), kind: String(list[i].select(".book-list-info-bottom-right-font").text()).replace(/[中已]/, ""), word: "", latest: "", intro: list[i].select(".book-list-info-desc").text(), cover: list[i].select("img").attr("data-original"), url: list[i].select("a").attr("href")
});
data = JSON.stringify(data);
</js>
$[:10]

chapters.listSelector:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
var list = java.getElements("#chapter_indexes ul li a");
data = [];
for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) data.push({
    name: list[i].text(), link: list[i].attr("href")
});
1 == flag ? (java.put("Enable", 1), JSON.stringify(data)) : java.toast("\n❗未启用书源❗");
</js>
$[*]
